entries.what: The analyst's confidence = confidence_floor + confidence_span x composite_score. Gated against the regime's base_min_confidence_score.
entries.pitfall: Not a probability of profit. It is a linear rescale of the composite score.

entries.what: Same number as confidence_score, repeated inside quant_metrics.
Weighted mean of the pillars present: technical, fundamental, sentiment (weights in the house rules), renormalised over the pillars that exist.
entries.pitfall: A missing pillar is dropped, not scored as zero: the composite can rest on technicals alone.

entries.what: Mean of all indicator sub-scores (/100), then blended 80/20 with the relative-strength score.
entries.pitfall: It AVERAGES contrarian sub-scores (RSI, Bollinger, stochastic, Williams, RSI-2, NW deviation) with trend sub-scores (SMA-200, EMA, MACD, golden cross, OBV). An extended leader and a falling knife can score within a few points of each other. Read the sub-scores, never this number alone.

entries.what: Mean of the fundamental sub-scores (pe, pb, roe, net_margin, current_ratio, debt_equity, eps_growth, revenue_growth) /100.
The analyst's news-headline sentiment pillar (0 all negative, 0.5 balanced, 1 all positive); 'n/a' when no headline contains a lexicon word.
entries.pitfall: 'n/a' means no signal, not neutral, and the composite then rests on the other pillars.

entries.what: Same lexicon pillar as analyst_sentiment_score, inside quant_metrics. Each headline scores 50+50*(pos-neg)/(pos+neg); headlines with no lexicon word are skipped.
entries.pitfall: One strongly negative headline among few can pull the pillar to 0.

entries.what: Number of HEADLINES that contained at least one lexicon word.
entries.pitfall: Headlines, not articles read in full.

entries.what: Weighted headline denominator used by the mean (a headline shared across tickers weighs less).
Lexicon WORD occurrences counted as positive.
entries.pitfall: Word counts, not article counts; they routinely exceed sentiment_articles (DL-112).

entries.what: Lexicon WORD occurrences counted as negative.
entries.pitfall: Word counts, not article counts (DL-112).

entries.what: The data provider's own sentiment number for the ticker (scale not declared in our code). It does not feed the analyst's composite.
entries.pitfall: A different scale and source from analyst_sentiment_score; do not compare the two numerically.

entries.what: 14-period Relative Strength Index, 0-100.
entries.pitfall: Scored contrarian: high RSI (overbought) gets a LOW sub-score.

entries.what: Sub-score of rsi.
entries.pitfall: rsi_score=25 means rsi >= 70 (overbought), not weak momentum.

entries.what: 2-period RSI, 0-100: a very short-term overbought/oversold gauge.
Sub-score of rsi2 (contrarian).
Where the close sits inside the Bollinger band: 0 = lower band, 1 = upper band.
entries.pitfall: Near the lower band is scored bullish (contrarian).

entries.what: Sub-score of bollinger_position.
Close's distance above (+) or below (-) its 200-day SMA, in %.
entries.pitfall: Trend-following: below the SMA-200 scores low.

entries.what: Sub-score of sma_distance_pct.
Short EMA minus long EMA as % of price (positive = up-trend).
Sub-score of ema_spread_pct.
MACD line minus signal line, in price units.
entries.pitfall: Its sub-score also depends on the sign of the MACD line, macd_line_price (absent from the production packet).
entries.bands: line>0 and histogram>0 -> 75; histogram>0 only -> 60; line<0 and histogram<0 -> 25; otherwise -> 45

entries.what: Sub-score from MACD line and histogram signs.
entries.bands: line>0 and histogram>0 -> 75; histogram>0 only -> 60; line<0 and histogram<0 -> 25; otherwise -> 45

entries.what: 1 when the 50-day SMA is above the 200-day SMA, else 0.
Sub-score of golden_cross.
On-balance volume level (cumulative signed volume).
entries.pitfall: The level itself means nothing; only OBV vs its signal line is scored.

entries.what: 70 when OBV is above its signal average (accumulation), else 35.
Average True Range as % of price: daily volatility.
entries.pitfall: Lower volatility scores higher. It also sizes the scaled stop.

entries.what: Sub-score of atr_pct.
Stochastic %K, 0-100: close within the recent high-low range.
entries.pitfall: Scored with %D (stochastic_d; absent from the production packet): oversold high, overbought low.

entries.what: Sub-score from %K and %D.
Williams %R, -100..0 (-100 = at the period low).
Sub-score of williams_r (contrarian).
Choppiness index 0-100: low = trending, high = range-bound.
Sub-score of choppiness.
Close's % deviation from a Nadaraya-Watson kernel-smoothed price line.
entries.pitfall: Below the smoothed line is scored bullish (contrarian).

entries.what: Sub-score of nw_deviation_pct.
1 when the turnaround pattern detector fires, else 0.
75 when turnaround fires, else neutral 50.
How many indicator sub-scores were averaged.
entries.pitfall: Fewer indicators = a noisier technical_score.

entries.what: Daily bars the analyst had for this ticker.
entries.pitfall: Below 200 the SMA-200 and golden cross cannot compute and are absent.

entries.what: ANALYST: the stock's trailing return minus the benchmark's (SPY) over the same window, in percentage points.
entries.pitfall: The SCANNER's relative_strength is a different metric with the same name: the stock's own total return as a fraction (0.12 = +12 %), with no benchmark. Check which block the value is in.

entries.what: Sub-score of the analyst relative_strength; blended 20 % into technical_score.
SUB-SCORE of the trailing P/E ratio (cheaper scores higher).
entries.pitfall: NOT the P/E ratio. The ratio is peBasicExclExtraTTM in the Fundamentals line. A loss-maker has no pe key at all.
entries.bands: raw = peBasicExclExtraTTM or peTTM; first match wins: raw < 10 -> 80; raw <= 25 -> 60; otherwise -> 30 Non-positive raw values are skipped (no key)

entries.what: SUB-SCORE of price/book (cheaper scores higher).
entries.pitfall: NOT the ratio; raw value is pbQuarterly.
entries.bands: raw = pbQuarterly or pbAnnual; first match wins: raw < 1.5 -> 80; raw <= 3 -> 60; raw <= 5 -> 40; otherwise -> 20 Non-positive raw values are skipped (no key)

entries.what: SUB-SCORE of return on equity.
entries.pitfall: NOT the ratio; raw value is roeTTM (in %).
entries.bands: raw = roeTTM; first match wins: raw > 15 -> 80; raw > 5 -> 55; otherwise -> 25

entries.what: SUB-SCORE of net profit margin.
entries.pitfall: Raw value is netProfitMarginTTM (in %).
entries.bands: raw = netProfitMarginTTM; first match wins: raw > 20 -> 80; raw > 10 -> 55; otherwise -> 30

entries.what: SUB-SCORE of the current ratio (liquidity).
entries.pitfall: Raw value is currentRatioQuarterly.
entries.bands: raw = currentRatioQuarterly; first match wins: raw > 1.5 -> 70; raw > 1 -> 50; otherwise -> 25 Non-positive raw values are skipped (no key)

entries.what: SUB-SCORE of debt/equity (less debt scores higher).
entries.pitfall: A HIGH debt_equity sub-score means LOW leverage.
entries.bands: raw = totalDebt/totalEquityQuarterly or totalDebt/totalEquityAnnual; first match wins: raw < 0.5 -> 80; raw < 1 -> 65; raw < 2 -> 45; otherwise -> 20

entries.what: SUB-SCORE of trailing EPS growth year on year.
entries.pitfall: Raw value is epsGrowthTTMYoy (in %).
entries.bands: raw = epsGrowthTTMYoy; first match wins: raw > 20 -> 85; raw > 5 -> 65; raw > -5 -> 45; otherwise -> 20

entries.what: SUB-SCORE of trailing revenue growth year on year.
entries.pitfall: Raw value is revenueGrowthTTMYoy (in %).
entries.bands: raw = revenueGrowthTTMYoy; first match wins: raw > 15 -> 80; raw > 5 -> 60; raw > -5 -> 45; otherwise -> 25
